definitions.explanation: Assistance provided to help or protect someone, originally military (covering fire) but now widely used figuratively to mean backing someone up or providing support.

examples.japanese: {仲間|なかま}を{援護|えんご}する。
{味方|みかた}の{援護|えんご}{射撃|しゃげき}で{前進|ぜんしん}できた。
examples.english: We were able to advance thanks to covering fire from our allies.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{自分|じぶん}の{意見|いけん}が{通|とお}ったのは、{先輩|せんぱい}の{援護|えんご}があったからだ。
examples.english: My opinion was accepted at the meeting because my senior colleague backed me up.

notes:
A compound of {援|えん} (aid) and {護|ご} (protect). Originally a military term for providing covering fire or protective support, now commonly used figuratively in everyday and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {援護|えんご}する — to provide support, to back up
- {援護|えんご}{射撃|しゃげき} — covering fire
- {援護|えんご}を{求|もと}める — to seek support
- {戦傷病者|せんしょうびょうしゃ}{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}{遺族|いぞく}{等|とう}{援護|えんご}{法|ほう} — war veterans' support law

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {支援|しえん} — support, assistance (broader, more general)
- {応援|おうえん} — cheering, support (encouraging someone)
- {援助|えんじょ} — aid, assistance (material or financial help)
- {庇護|ひご} — protection, patronage (sheltering from harm)
